summary: Cash, what comes in and what goes out, with a date and a currency.
author: BrainDog

declarations.name: Bills and invoices
declarations.holds: the bills you are to pay and the invoices you are to be paid, each with a day and a currency
declarations.title: what

declarations.name: Accounts
declarations.holds: what is in each bank account, cash box and card, and the day that was true
declarations.title: name

declarations.name: Exchange rates
declarations.holds: what one currency is worth in another, and the day that was true
declarations.title: currency

declarations.name: Categories
declarations.holds: what money is for, so a ledger can be read by where it goes
declarations.title: name

declarations.name: Ledger
declarations.holds: money that has moved, with the day it moved, the account it moved through and what it was for
declarations.title: what

declarations.name: Repeating
declarations.holds: the money that comes in and goes out on a cadence, weekly to yearly, without anybody deciding again. Next is the next payment, and the days of the month every one after it
declarations.title: what

declarations.name: Instalments
declarations.holds: the parts of something paid over time, and the day each part falls due
declarations.title: what

declarations.name: Balance checks
declarations.holds: what an account held on a day, as a statement, a bank message or a count said it
declarations.title: source

declarations.name: Snapshots
declarations.holds: what the money was on a night, so a figure can be compared with the day it was true
declarations.title: what

declarations.name: Books
declarations.holds: the sets of money you keep apart, such as your own and a company you run, each read on its own page
declarations.title: name

Invoices past their due date: {{late-in}} still to come in.
Bills past their due date: {{overdue}} still to pay.
Categories holding money going the other way from how they are marked: {{categories-against-direction}}. Make it either way: in Categories, set Which way to Either way.
